key_findings.kite_equity_master_equity_tokens: CONFIRMED — _sync_kite_option_master_daily writes equity tokens to kite_equity_master collection. _fetch_kite_hist_ohlcv_for_equity queries it for instrument_token.

key_findings.multibagger_rsi_fix: CONFIRMED — compute_multibagger_analysis uses _real_rsi = fundamental.get('rsi') at higher precedence than proxy formula 30 + (position * 40). Fallback proxy still preserved.
key_findings.vix_scaled_price_bands: CONFIRMED — compute_realistic_price_bands in indicators.py has india_vix param (default=None). Scaling activates when india_vix > 15 (widens hist_vol to max(hist_vol, vix_annualized * 0.80)).
key_findings.fetch_hist_one_returns_dict: CONFIRMED — _fetch_hist_one returns (symbol, {hist_vol, rsi, trend_alignment}) dict, not just hist_vol float.
key_findings.startup_garbage_purge: CONFIRMED — startup_tasks purges custom_positions with buy_price>=999000 OR expiry_date=None/missing. API confirms no garbage records.
